mentions.name: Software Delegate
mentions.description: This tool lets users delegate a task or GitHub issue to an automated AI coding agent that writes the code, runs checks, reads failures, fixes problems, and iterates until the result is good, then returns a pull request — automating the full workflow of a human developer.
mentions.source_excerpt: You delegate a task or GitHub issue to it and it uses AI coding agents and developer tools to write the code, run checks, read failures, fix problems, and iterate until the result is good, then comes back with a pull request. It does everything a human dev would do, fully automated.
